India Cricket Team Arrives in Sri Lanka for Test Series

The Indian cricket team has arrived in Sri Lanka for a two-match Test series scheduled to begin on August 15. The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has added four players as net bowlers to assist the team. Reports indicate discussions about the futures of Gautam Gambhir and Ajit Agarkar are linked to the series outcomes, following a significant shake-up after the England series. The team is preparing for Sri Lanka's spin-bowling strategy, with four types of spinners included in the net bowlers' lineup.
